portInfo.description: The old town and museum lie on the river side, while Praia da Rocha and Santa Catarina face the sea. Alcalar’s prehistoric monuments are outside the city; the museum’s related finds do not mean the tombs are inside the waterfront museum. Ferragudo and Benagil need extra transport research, not an assumed quick detour.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Portimão Museum — Museu de Portimão, Arade waterfront, Portimão. An indoor local-history/archaeology anchor; the Alcalar operator notes related finds here. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
Santa Catarina de Ribamar Fort — Av. Tomás Cabreira 4, 8500-802 Portimão. A specific fort at Praia da Rocha, not the cruise terminal. Allow 40 minutes; official source.
Praia da Rocha — Praia da Rocha seafront, Portimão. A beach/boardwalk choice; seasonal facilities and safe bathing are not guaranteed. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
Main Church of Portimão — Main Church of Nossa Senhora da Conceição, Portimão old town. A distinct old-town religious stop, subject to services. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
Jesuit College church — Igreja do Colégio, Portimão old town. A separate mapped civic/religious landmark. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: For Alcalar, specify the on-site monuments/interpretation centre. A search result that sends you only to Portimão Museum is not the same visit.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Allow 30 minutes for the permitted terminal exit and waterfront museum approach; confirm whether the ship/port requires a shuttle before walking. Budget 30–45 minutes for Praia da Rocha by local vehicle/walk combination and 45–60 minutes for an Alcalar road approach, including access/pickup. These are planning allowances, not sourced road distances.
